description: You are the Protoss commander on Odyssey LE, facing a Terran commander in an early cross-race fight where the side gold base can give the faster economy and the stronger follow-up to whichever side commits more force there. You have one Nexus, 13 Probes, two Gateways, a Cybernetics Core, a Forge, two Stalkers, three Zealots, 640 minerals, and 278 gas, so you can send a meaningful squad toward the gold but only by pulling units away from your main position. The Terran has shown only a Reaper and a KD8 Charge, with no visible army mass, so their remote presence is minimal, but you do not know whether they are preparing a larger response behind that scout. If your force arrives at the gold base with more weight, you secure the richer income and the tempo to expand faster; if the Terran leaned harder, the units and attention you sent there are still tied up and missing from the rest of your defense.
